Northern Sotho: Sengwalwa se se hlagiša mabaka le maemo ao a bakago go tloša/go ripa ditho tša bong tša basadi (FGM/C) ka maemong a itšego ka dinageng tše tharo – tša Indonesia, Ethiopia le Kenya.

Luganda: Obubaka bwakuŋŋaanyizibwa n’enkalala z’ebibuuzo ezaaweebwa abavubuka (abali wakati w’emyaka 15-24) mu maka awamu n’okuyita mu nkola ey’okukubaganya ebirowoozo okw’omu bibinja, okubuuza abavubuka ebibuuzo awamu n’okubuuza abantu ab’enkizo mu kitundu ebibuuzo mu mwaka gwa 2016 ne 2017.
Yoruba: Data náà jẹ́ gbígbà nípa ìlànà ṣíṣe òdiwọ̀n àwọn ọ̀dọ́mọdé tí wọ́n gbé nínú ilé kan (ọmọ ọdun 15-24) àti fífọ̀rọ̀jomitoro ọ̀rọ̀ àwọn ọ̀wọ́ kan, ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò tó jínlẹ̀ àti ṣíṣe ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò pẹ̀lú àwọn ọ̀dọ́ àti àwọn abẹnugan agbègbè ní ọdún 2016 àti ọdún 2017.

Hausa: An tattara bayanai ta hanyar binciken gida tare da matasa (shekaru 15-24) da kuma ta hanyar tattaunawa ta rukuni, tattaunawa mai zurfi da kuma mahimman tambayoyin masu bayars da labari tare da matasa da masu ruwa da tsaki a cikin shekarar 2016 da kuma shekarar 2017.

English: The study findings confirm some of the reasons for FGM/C documented by previous studies, noting that these reasons are strongly interconnected, and gender norms are the underlying driver.
Luganda: Ebyazuulibwa mu kunoonyereza bikakasa ezimu ku nsonga eziviirako FGM/C ezeeyolekera mu kunoonyereza okwakolebwa mu biseera eby’emabega, ekiraga nti ensonga zino zirina enkolagana ya maanyi nnyo, era ng’ennono z’ekikula ze ziviirako kino.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí rí àwọn ìdí kan tó fẹsẹ̀ múlẹ nípa FGM/C tí ìwádìí ti tẹ́lẹ̀ ti ṣe ìgbàsílẹ̀ rẹ̀, kò sí àní-àní pé àwọn ìdí wọ́nyìí ní ìbátan tó rínlẹ̀, àti pé àwọn òfin àwùjọ tó ń mójútó ìṣakọṣabo ló jẹ́ ohun tó ń ṣokùn fàá.
Zulu: Imiphumela yocwaningo iqinisekisa ezinye zezizathu ze-FGM/C ezibhalwe ngokocwaningo lwangaphambilini, kuphawula ukuthi lezi zizathu zixhumene kakhulu, futhi izinkambiso zobulili ziyimbangela eyinhloko.
Hausa: Sakamakon binciken ya tabbatar da wasu dalilai na FGM/C da aka rubuta ta binciken da aka yi a baya, lura da cewa waɗannan dalilai suna da alaƙa da juna sosai, kuma ƙajidodin jinsi su ne musabbabin tushen.
Northern Sotho: Dikutollo tša dinyakišišo di tiišetša a mangwe a mabaka a FGM/C ao a ilego a ngwalwa ke dinyakišišo tše di fetilego, tšeo di lemogilego gore mabaka a a amane kudu, ebile le ditlwaedi ka ga bong ke tšona di bakago se.
Amharic: የጥናቱ ግኝቶች በፊት የተደረጉ ጥናቶች ለ FGM/C መንስኤዎች ናቸው ብለው የዘገቧቸውን ምክንያቶች የሚያረጋግጡ ሲሆን፣ እነዚህ ምክንያቶች እጅግ የተያያዙ እንደሆኑ እና የስርአተ-ጾታ ደንቦች ዋነኞቹ ነጂዎች እንደሆኑ አሳስበዋል።

English: In all three settings, these reasons drive the alterations of female bodies to result in a ‘cultured’ body that is acceptable to the patriarchal status quo.
Luganda: Mu mawanga gonsatule, ensonga zino ze ziviirako okukyusakyusa emibiri gy’abakyala okusobola okufuna omubiri omuwunde mu nnono z’obuwangwa era ogukkirizibwa mu nkola efugibwa abasajja.
Yoruba: Nínú gbogbo àwọn ìlànà mẹ́tẹ̀ẹta , ìdí yìí ló jẹ́ kí àtúnṣe kékeré débá ara àwọn obìnrin tó jẹ́ ìtẹ́wọ́gbà nínú ìṣèjọba àwọn ọkùnrin.
Zulu: Kuzo zontathu lezi zilungiselelo, lezi zizathu ziqhuba ukuguqulwa kwemizimba yabesifazane ukuze kubangele umzimba ‘okhuliswe isiko’ owamukelekayo esimweni sokhokho.
Hausa: A cikin dukkan wuraren guda uku, waɗannan dalilai suna haifar da sauye-sauye na jikin mata don haifar da jiki mai 'al’ada' wanda ya dace da matsayin sarki.
Northern Sotho: Ka maemong ka moka a mararo, mabaka a a baka go ripa ditho tša mebele ya basadi gore se se feletše ka mmele wa ‘setšo’ wo o amogelegago go seemo sa go se fetoge seo se ratwago ke banna.
Amharic: በሶሱቱም መቸቶች እነዚህ ምክንያቶች የሴት ልጅ ሰውነትን በመቀየር ”ባህላዊ” እና በተለመደው የፓትሪያርካል ስረአት ተቀባይነት ያለውን ሰውነት ለማምጣት ያለሙ ናቸው።

English: This results in the ‘pure body’ in Indonesia, the ‘tame’ body in Ethiopia and the ‘adult body’ in Kenya.
Luganda: Kino kiviirako okubeera “n’omubiri omutukuvu” mu ggwanga lya Indonesia, omubiri ‘omukkakkamu’ mu ggwanga lya Ethiopia “n’omubiri gw’ekikulu” mu ggwanga lya Kenya.
Yoruba: Èsì ti ‘ara tó mọ́’ ní Indonesia, ti ‘ara tí kò le’ ní Ethiopia àti èsì ‘ara ọ̀dọ́ nílẹ̀ Kenya.
Zulu: Lokhu kubangela ‘umzimba ohlanzekile’ e-Indonesia, umzimba ‘othambile’ e-Ethiopia kanye ‘nomzimba wabadala’ eKenya.
Hausa: Wannan yana haifar da 'jiki mai tsabta' a ƙasar Indonesiya, jikin 'tame' a ƙasar Habasha da kuma 'jikin manya' a ƙasar Kenya.
Northern Sotho: Se se feleletša ka ‘mmele wo o hlwekilego’ ka Indonesia, mmele wo o ‘hlamilwego’ ka Ethiopia le ‘mmele wa motho wo mogolo’ ka Kenya.
Amharic: ይህም በኢንዶኔዥያ ‘ንጹህ ሰውነትን’፣ በኢትዮጵያ ‘የተጨመተ’ ሰውነትን እና በኬኒያ ደግሞ ‘የአዋቂ ገላ’ የሚባለውን ያስከስታል።

English: Health workers and parents play an important role in decision-making around FGM/C in all settings.
Luganda: Abeebyobulamu n’abazadde bakola omulimu gwa muwendo mu kukola okusalawo okukwata ku FGM/C mu bitundu byonna.
Yoruba: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ elétò ìléra àti àwọn òbi ń ko ipa tó ṣe pàtàkì nínú ṣíṣe ìpinnu láàárín FGM/C ní gbogbo ọ̀nà.
Zulu: Abasebenzi bezempilo nabazali badlala indima ebalulekile ekuthathweni kwezinqumo mayelana ne-FGM/C kuzo zonke izimo.
Hausa: Ma'aikatan lafiya da iyaye suna taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen yanke shawara game da FGM/C a duk wurare.
Northern Sotho: Bašomi ba tša maphelo le batswadi ba raloka tema ye bohlokwa go tšea diphetho mabapi le FGM/C ka maemong ka moka.
Amharic: የጤና ሰራተኞች እና ወላጆች በሁሉም መቸቶች በ FGM/C ዙሪያ ለሚደረጉ ውሳኔዎች ወሳኝ ሚና ይጫወታሉ።

English: In Kenya, in particular, young women negotiate their role in decision-making around FGM/C as they are older at the time of circumcision.
Luganda: Bwe kituuka mu Kenya, abawala abato boogerezeganya ku mulimu gwabwe gwe balina mu kukola okusalawo okwetooloolera ku FGM/C kubanga babeera bakulu mu kiseera okukomolebwa we kukolebwa.
Yoruba: Pàápàá jùlọ ní Kenya àwọn ọ̀dọ́bìnrin ló má ń ṣe ìpinnu wọn lóri FGM/C ní kété tí wọ́n bá tí ń dàgbà fún abẹ́ dídá.
Zulu: E-Kenya, ikakhulukazi, abesifazane abasebasha baxoxisana ngendima yabo ekuthathweni kwezinqumo mayelana ne-FGM/C njengoba sebekhulile ngesikhathi sokusokwa.
Hausa: A ƙasar Kenya, musamman, mata matasa suna tattaunawa game da rawar da suke takawa wajen yanke shawara game da FGM/C yayin da suka girma a lokacin kaciyar.
Northern Sotho: Ka Kenya, kudukudu, basetsana ba rerišana ka ga ditema tše ba di kgathago mabapi le go tšea dipheto ka ga FGM/C ka ge ba tla be ba le ba bagolo ka nakong ya lebollo.
Amharic: በተለይም በኬኒያ፣ ወጣት ሴቶች በ FGM/C ዙሪያ ለሚደረጉ ውሳኔዎች ያለቸውን ሚና ይደራደራሉ ምክንያቱም ግርዛት በሚደረግበት ጊዜ እድሚያቸው ከፍ ያለ ስለሆነ ነው።

English: The study reveals how the changing legal and social contexts in each setting bring about changes in the tradition of FGM/C resulting in medicalization of FGM/C in Indonesia, a lowered age of cutting for girls in Kenya and the increasingly underground practice of FGM/C in Ethiopia.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwoleka engeri enkyukakyuka ezeekuusa ku by’amateeka n’embeerabantu mu buli kitundu gye zireetawo enkyukakyuka mu nnono ya FGM/C ne kiviirako FGM/C okukolebwa mu malwaliro mu ggwanga lya Indonesia, okukendeeza ku myaka gy’okukomolebwa kw’abawala mu Kenya n’okweyongera kw’enkola ya FGM/C mu Ethiopia.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí ṣe ìṣípayá bí ìyípadà òfin àti ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àwùjọ nínú àwọn ètò kọ̀ọ̀kan ṣe mú ìyípadà bá ṣíṣe FGM/C tí ó wá padà jásí kí àwọn akọ́ṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ ẹlẹ́tò ìlera máa kópa nínú FGM/C ní indonesia, ìdínkù ọjọ́ orí fún àwọn ọmọdébìnrin ní Kenya àti bí ìkópa FGM/C ṣe ń gbòrò sí lábẹ́lẹ̀ ní Ethiopia.
Zulu: Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi ukushintsha kwezimo zomthetho nezenhlalo endaweni ngayinye kulethe kanjani izinguquko esikweni le-FGM/C okuholela ekwelashweni kwe-FGM/C e-Indonesia, ukuncipha kweminyaka yokusikwa kwamantombazane eKenya kanye nomkhuba owumshoshaphansi owandayo we-FGM/ C e-Ethiopia.
Hausa: Binciken ya bayyana yadda sauye-sauyen yanayi na shari'a da zamantakewa a kowane wuri ya haifar da sauye-sauyen a al'adar FGM/C wanda ke haifar da likitanci na FGM/C a ƙasar Indonesiya, rage shekarun yanke wa 'yan mata a ƙasar Kenya da kuma ƙara yawan aikin FGM/ C a ƙasar habasha.

English: Female genital mutilation, a practice where parts of the female sex organs are cut or removed, still happens illegally or in secret in countries like Kenya, Ethiopia and Indonesia.
Luganda: Okukomolebwa kw’abakyala, enkola mwe tulabira ng’ebitundu ebimu ebibeera mu bukyala bw’abakyala bisaliddwa oba ne biggyibwamu, kukyakolebwa mu bumenyi bw’amateeka oba mu nkukutu mu mawanga nga Kenya, Ethiopia ne Indonesia.
Yoruba: Dídábẹ́ fóbìnrin, ó jẹ́ ìṣesí kan tó dálé gígé tàbí yíyọ lára ojú ara obìnrin, tí ó sì ń ṣẹlẹ̀ láìtọ́ tàbí níkọ̀kọ̀ ní àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè bí i Kenya, Ethiopia àti Indonesia.
Zulu: Ukucwiywa kwezitho zangasese zabesifazane, umkhuba lapho izingxenye zezitho zobulili zabesifazane zisikwa noma zikhishwa, kusenzeka ngokungekho emthethweni noma ngasese emazweni afana neKenya, Ethiopia ne-Indonesia.
Hausa: Kaciyar mata, al’adar da ake yanke ko cire sassan sassan jikin mace, har yanzu tana faruwa ba bisa ƙa'ida ba ko kuma a asirce a ƙasashe irin su Kenya da Habasha da kuma Indonesiya.
Northern Sotho: Go ripa ditho tša bong tša basadi, e lego tiro yeo go yona ditho tša bong tša basadi di ripšwago goba tša tlošwa, go sa direga ka fao go sego molaong goba ka sephiring ka dinageng tša go swana le Kenya, Ethiopia le Indonesia.
Amharic: የሴት ልጅ የመራቢያ አካላት የሚቆረጡበት ወይም የሚወገዱበት የሴት ልጅ ግርዛት አሁንም ድረስ ህገወጥ በሆነ መንገድ ወይም በድብቅ እንደ ኬኒያ፣ ኢትዮጵያ እን ኢንዶኔዥያ ባሉ ሃገራት ይካሄዳል።

English: Researchers say that understanding why it happens is the key to stopping this harmful tradition, and preventing the health and psychological problems women suffer as a result.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti okutegeera ensonga lwaki kukolebwa ky’ekintu ekikulu ekisobola okuyambako mu kukomya ennono eno erimu obulumi obutagambika, awamu n’okuziyiza ebizibu ku bulamu n’obwongo abakyala bye bafuna okuva mu nkola eyo.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé níní òye nípa ìdí tí ó ṣé ń ṣẹlẹ̀ ni kọ́kọ́rọ́ láti dẹ́kun ìṣesí ìpalára yìí àti láti dáàbòbò ìléra àti ìṣòro ajẹmọ́ ìròrí tí àwọn obìnrin má ń jìyà rẹ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi ukuqonda ukuthi kungani kwenzeka kuyisihluthulelo sokumisa leli siko eliyingozi, nokuvimbela izinkinga zempilo nezengqondo abesifazane ababhekana nazo ngenxa yalokho.

Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bolela gore go kwešiša gore ke ka lebaka la eng se se direga go bohlokwa go thibela setlwaedi se se nago le tshenyo, le go thibela mathata a tša maphelo le a menagagno ao basadi ba itemogelago ona ka lebaka la se.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች እንደሚሉት ለምን እንደሚከሰት መረዳት ይህንን ጎጂ ባህል ለማቆም እና በዚህ ምክንያት ሴቶች የሚያጋጥማቸውን ስነልቦናዊ እና የጤና ችግሮች ለመከላከል ዋናው ነገር ነው።

English: In parts of Africa and Asia, female genital mutilation (FGM), which is sometimes called ‘female circumcision’, is still commonly practiced.
Luganda: Mu bitundu bya Afirika ne Asia, okukomola ebitundu by’abakyala (FGM) ekitera okuyitibwa ‘okukomelebwa kw’abakyala’ kukyakolebwa nnyo.
Yoruba: Ní àwọn apá ibìkan ní Africa àti Asia, dídábẹ́ fóbìnrin (FGM), tí a tún lè pè ní ‘gíge ojú abẹ́ obìnrin’ si jẹ́ ohun tí wọ́n sì ń ṣe.
Zulu: Ezingxenyeni ezithile zase-Afrika nase-Asia, ukucwiliswa kwezitho zangasese kwabesifazane (FGM), ngezinye izikhathi okubizwa ngokuthi ‘ukusokwa kwabesifazane’, kusavame ukwenziwa.
Hausa: A sassan Afirka da Asiya, ana ci gaba da yin kaciya ta mata (FGM), wanda wani lokaci ake kira da ‘kaciyar mata’.
Northern Sotho: Ka dikarolong tša Afrika le tša Asia, go ripa ditho tša bong tša basadi (FGM), seo ka dinako tše dingwe se bitšwago ‘lebollo la basadi’, go sa dirwa ka fao go tlwaelegilego.
Amharic: በተወሰኑ የአፍሪካ እና የኤስያ ክፍሎች የሴት ልጅ ግርዛት (FGM) አንዳንዴም ‘የሴት ልጅ የብልት ቆረጣ’ በመባል የሚታወቀው አሁንም በተለምዶ ይተገበራል።

English: Many people falsely believe that FGM is necessary for proper hygiene or to keep women modest (free of vanity and humble), and to make sure they will be able to have children.
Luganda: Abantu bangi balina enzikiriza enkyamu nti FGM yeetagisa okusobola okubeera abayonjo oba okukuuma abakyala nga bawombeefu (obutaba na kwewulira kususse awamu n’okubeera abakkakkamu), awamu n’okukakasa nti bajja kusobola okuzaala abaana.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn èèyàn nígbàgbọ́ èké lóri pé FGM ṣe pàtàkì fún ìmọ́tótó tó dára tàbí láti tọ́jú ìmúrasí àwọn obìnrin (ìtúsílẹ̀ lọ́wọ́ asán àti ìwà ìrẹ̀lẹ̀), àti láti ri dájú pé wọ́n lẹ̀ rí ọmọ bí.
Zulu: Abantu abaningi bakholelwa ngamanga ukuthi i-FGM iyadingeka ukuze kube nenhlanzeko efanele noma ukugcina abesifazane benesizotha (bengenalo ize futhi bethobekile), futhi baqiniseke ukuthi bazokwazi ukuthola abantwana.
Hausa: Mutane da yawa sun yi imani da ƙarya cewa FGM ta zama dole don tsafta mai kyau ko don kiyaye mata masu tawali'u (ba tare da ‘yancin banza da tawali'u ba), da kuma don tabbatar da cewa za su iya haihuwa.
Northern Sotho: Batho ba bantši ga ba dumela ka fao e sego nnete gore FGM e a hlokega gore basadi ba be le maphelo a maleba goba go dira gore basadi ba hlomphege (ba hloke seriti le gore ba ikokobetše), le go netefatša gore ba tla kgona go ba le bana.
Amharic: ብዙ ሰዎች FGM ለንጽህና እና ሴት ልጆችን ጭምት ለማድረግ (ከከንቱ ባህሪያት የጸዱ እና ትሁት የሆኑ) ለማድረግ እና ልጆች እንደሚኖራቸው ለማረጋገጥ ይጠቅማል የሚል የተሳሳተ እምነት አላቸው።

English: FGM is not required for any of these according to scientific evidence.
Luganda: FGM teyeetaagisa kukolebwa okusobola okutuukiriza wadde ekimu ku bino okusinziira ku bukakafu obw’ekinassaayansi.
Yoruba: A kò nílò FGM fún èyíkèyí nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí gẹ́gẹ́ bí ẹ̀rí ìmọ̀ sáyẹ́nsì ṣe sọ.
Zulu: I-FGM ayidingeki kunoma yikuphi kwalokhu ngokobufakazi besayensi.
Hausa: Ba a buƙatar FGM ga ɗayan waɗannan bisa ga shaidar kimiyya.
Northern Sotho: FGM ga e nyakege go tše dingwe tša dilo tše go ya ka bohlatse bja tša mahlale.
Amharic: ከሳይንስ መረጃ እንደተገኘው ለእነዚህ ጉዳዮች FGM አያስፈልግም።

English: In many cases, however, children subjected to FGM end up with health problems later in life, like harmful infections, difficulty urinating (weeing), and mental health issues.
Luganda: Wabula kiri nti mu mbeera nnyingi, abaana abakolebwako FGM bakomekkereza bafunye obuzibu mu bulamu bwabwe mu biseera eby’omu maaso, gamba ng’okukwatibwa obuwuka obw’obulabe, okukaluubirirwa mu kufuuyisa (okufuka), awamu n’obuzibu obulala obwekuusa ku bwongo.
Yoruba: Ní ọ̀pọ̀ ìgbà, àwọn ọmọdé tí wọ́n bá ṣe FGM má ń padà ní ìṣòro ìléra ara lọ́jọ́ iwájú bí i ìkóràn tó lè ṣàkóbá fúnni, ìṣòro láti tọ̀ (ìtọ̀ títọ̀) àti ìṣòro ìléra ajẹmọ́ ọpọlọ.
Zulu: Ezimweni eziningi, nokho, izingane ezingaphansi kwe-FGM zigcina zinezinkinga zempilo kamuva ekuphileni, njengezifo eziyingozi, ubunzima bokuchama (ukushobinga), nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo.
Hausa: A lokuta da yawa, duk da haka, yaran da aka yi wa FGM suna ƙarewa da matsalolin lafiya daga baya a rayuwa, kamar cututtuka masu cutarwa da wahalar fitsari (fitsari), da kuma lamuran lafiyar hankali.
Northern Sotho: Mabakeng a mantši, le ge go le bjale, bana bao ba dirwago FGM ba feleletša ba na le mathata a tša maphelo ka moragonyana bophelong bja bona, go swana le go ba le diphetetšo tše kotsi, go swara bothata go hlapologa (go rota), le go mathata a maphelo a menagano.
Amharic: ነገር ግን በብዙ ሁኔታዎች ለFGM የተጋለጡ ልጆች እድሚያቸው ሲገፋ እንደ ጎጂ ኢንፌክሽኖች፣ በመሽናት ጊዜ መቸገር (ሽንት መሽናት) እና የስነልቦና ችግሮች የመሳሰሉ ብዙ የጤና እክሎች ያጋጥሟቸዋል ።

English: Because the practice is so harmful and violates women's human rights, many countries have made it illegal, but people still do it secretly.
Luganda: Olw’okuba ng’enkola ya bulabe nnyo era ng’etyoboola eddembe ly’abakyala, amawanga mangi gagiweze, naye abantu bakyakikola mu nkola mu nkukutu.
Yoruba: Nítorí pé ìṣesí yìí ní ìpalára àti ìlòdì sẹ́tọ̀ọ́ àwọn obìnrin, púpọ̀ nínú àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè ti sọọ́di àìtọ́ àmọ́ àwọn èèyàn ṣì ń ṣeé ní ìkọ̀kọ̀.
Zulu: Ngenxa yokuthi lo mkhuba uyingozi futhi uhlukumeza amalungelo abantu besifazane, amazwe amaningi akwenze kwabe ngokungekho semthethweni, kodwa abantu basawenza ngasese.
Hausa: Domin wannan al’adar tana da illa da kuma keta haƙƙin mata ne, ƙasashe da dama sun haramta ta, amma har yanzu mutane suna yin hakan a asirce.
Northern Sotho: Ka lebaka la gore tiro ye e kotsi kudu ebile e tshela ditokelo tša botho tša basadi, dinaga tše ntši di e dirile gore e se be molaong, eupša batho ba sa e dira ka sephiring.
Amharic: ተግባሩ በጣም ጎጂ ስለሆነ እና የሴት ልጅን ሰብአዊ መብት ስለሚጋፋ፣ ብዙ ሃገሮች ህገወጥ አድርገውታል፣ ሰዎች ግን አሁንም ድረስ በድብቅ ያደርጉታል።

English: In this study, researchers wanted to understand more about why FGM happens in different countries, and what people believe about the practice.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereeza baayagala okwongera okutegeera ensonga ezireetera FGM ekolebwa mu mawanga ag’enjawulo, na biki abantu bye bakkiririzaamu mu nkola eyo.
Yoruba: Nínú ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ ní òye si nípa ìdí tí FGM ṣé ń ṣẹlẹ̀ ní oríṣríṣi orílẹ̀ èdè, àti nǹkan tí àwọn èèyàn gbàgbọ́ nípa ìṣesí yìí.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bebefuna ukuqonda kabanzi ngokuthi kungani i-FGM yenzeka emazweni ahlukene, nokuthi yini abantu abayikholelwayo ngalo mkhuba.
Hausa: A cikin wannan binciken, masu bincike sun so su ƙara fahimtar dalilin da ya sa FGM yake faruwa a ƙasashe daban-daban, da abin da mutane suka yi imani game da aikin.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go kwešiša tše ntši mabapi le ka fao FGM e diregago ka gona ka dinageng tšeo di fapafapanego, le seo batho ba se dumelago mabapi le tiro ye.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች በተለያዩ ሃገራት FGM ለምን እንደሚከሰት ለመረዳት እና ሰዎች ስለተግባሩ ምን እንደሚያምኑ ለማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር።

English: They therefore collected information about FGM in Kenya, Ethiopia and Indonesia.
Luganda: Noolwekyo baakuŋŋaanya obubaka obukwata ku FGM mu ggwanga lya Kenya, Ethiopia ne Indonesia.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sì tẹ̀síwájú láti gba ìròyìn tó dá lóri FGM ní Kenya, Ethiopia àti Indonesia.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke baqoqa ulwazi mayelana ne-FGM eKenya, e-Ethiopia nase-Indonesia.
Hausa: Don haka, sun tattara bayanai game da FGM a ƙasashen Kenya da Habasha da kuma Indonesia.
Northern Sotho: Ka fao ba ile ba kgoboketša tshedimošo ka ga FGM ka Kenya, Ethiopia le Indonesia.
Amharic: ስለዚህ፣ በኬኒያ፣ በኢትዮጵያ እና በኢንዶኔዥያ ስለ FGM መረጃ ሰብስበው ነበር።

English: In each country, the researchers talked to people about the practice, including parents, young people, traditional leaders, health workers, and ‘circumcisers’ (older women who used to perform FGM on young girls).
Luganda: Mu buli ggwanga, abanoonyereza baayogera n’abantu ku nkola eyo, omuli abazadde, abaana abato, abakulembeze ab’ennono, abeebyobulamu, ‘n’abakomozi’ (abakyala abakulu abaakolanga FGM ku bawala abato).
Yoruba: Ní àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè kọ̀ọ̀kan, àwọn aṣèwádìí bá àwọn èyàn sọ̀rọ̀ nípa ṣíṣe yìí, tó fi mọ́ àwọn òbí, àwọn ọmọdé, àwọn olórí, àwọn òṣìṣé elétò ìlera àti ‘àwọn tí à ń dábẹ́ fún ni’ (àwọn ìyá àgbàlagbà tí wọ́n má ń ṣe FGM fún àwọn ọmọdébìnrin).
Zulu: Ezweni ngalinye, abacwaningi bakhuluma nabantu ngalo mkhuba, okuhlanganisa abazali, intsha, abaholi bendabuko, abasebenzi bezempilo, kanye ‘nabasokayo’ (abesifazane abadala ababevame ukwenza i-FGM emantombazaneni amancane).
Hausa: A kowace ƙasa, masu binciken sun yi magana da mutane game da al’dar, ciki har da iyaye da matasa da shugabannin gargajiya da ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya da kuma 'masu kaciya' (tsofaffin mata da suka saba yi wa 'yan mata FGM).
Northern Sotho: Ka nageng ye nngwe le ye nngwe, banyakišiši ba ile ba boledišana le batho ka ga tiro ye, go akaretšwa batswad, bafsa, baetapele ba setšo, bašomi ba tša maphelo, le ‘maemo’ (basadi ba bagolo bao ba bego ba dira FGM go basetsana).
Amharic: በእያንዳንዱ ሃገር ተመራማሪዎች ስለተግባሩ ከወላጆች ፣ ከወጣቶች ፣ ከባህላዊ መሪዎች፣ ከጤና ሰራተኞች እና ከ‘ገራዦች’ (ወጣት ሴቶች ላይ FGMን የሚተገብሩ ትልልቅ ሴቶች) ከመሳሰሉ የተለያዩ ሰዎች ጋር ተነጋግረዋለው።

English: In some cases, they interviewed these people individually, but they also spoke with groups of people, including younger adults and teenagers, who had suffered FGM.
Luganda: Mu mbeera ezimu, baabuuza abantu bano ebibuuzo mu ngeri ya kinnoomu, naye ate era baayogerako n’ebibinja by’abantu, omuli abavubuka n’abatiini abaali baakolebwako FGM.
Yoruba: Lọ́nà mìíràn ẹ̀wẹ̀, wọ́n ṣe ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò fún àwọn èèyàn lẹ́yọkọ̀ọ̀kan, àmọ́ wọ́n tún bá àkójọpọ̀ àwọn èèyàn sọ̀rọ̀, tó fi mọ́ àwọn ọ̀dọ́mọdé àti àwọn màjèṣín.
Zulu: Kwezinye izimo, baxoxisana nalaba bantu ngabanye, kodwa baphinde bakhulume namaqembu abantu, kuhlanganise nabantu abadala abasebancane kanye nentsha, abaye bahlushwa i-FGM.
Hausa: A wasu lokuta, sun tattauna da waɗannan ɗaiɗaikun mutane, amma kuma sun yi magana da ƙungiyoyin mutane, ciki har da manya da matasa, waɗanda suka yi fama da FGM.
Northern Sotho: Mabakeng a mangwe, ba ile ba botšiša batho ba dipotšišo ka o tee ka o tee, eupša ba ile ba boledišana gape le dihlopha tša batho, go akaretšwa bafsa le bafsa ba mahlalagading, bao ba ilego ba itemogela gabohloko FGM.
Amharic: በአንዳንድ ሁኔታዎች እነዚህን ሰዎች የግል ቃለመጠይቅ ያደረጉላቸው ሲሆን በFGM ምክንያት የተሰቃዩ ወጣት አዋቂዎች እና ታዳጊ ወጣቶችን ጨምሮ ከብዙ ሰዎች ጋርም በአንዴ ተነጋግረዋል።

English: The researchers found that the reasons for FGM, the way it was done, and beliefs about the practice, were different in each country.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baazuula ng’ensonga eziviirako FGM, engeri gye yali ekolebwamu, awamu n’enzikiriza abantu ze balina ku nkola eyo, byali bya njawulo mu buli ggwanga.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣàwárí àwọn ìdí fún FGM, ọ̀nà tí wọ́n fín ṣeé, àti ìgbàgbọ́ nípa ṣíṣe rẹ̀, ó yàtọ̀ ní àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè kànkàn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi izizathu zeFGM, indlela okwenziwa ngayo, nezinkolelo ngalo mkhuba, zihlukene ezweni ngalinye.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa dalilai na FGM, yadda ake yin shi, da kuma imani game da aikin, sun bambanta a kowace ƙasa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba utollotše gore mabaka a FGM, ka fao e bego e dirwa ka gona, le ditumelo ka ga tiro ye, di be di fapane ka nageng ye nngwe le ye nngwe.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የFGM ምክንያቱ፣ የሚከናወንበት መንገድ እና ስለተግባሩ ያሉ እምነቶች በእያንዳንዱ ሃገር የተለያዩ እደሆኑ አግኝተዋል።

English: They also found out that many people still practised it, even in places where it was illegal.
Luganda: Mu ngeri endala era baazuula ng’abantu bangi bakyagikozesa, omwo nno nga mwe muli n’ebifo mw’etakkirizibwa.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ri pé ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn èèyàn ṣì ń ṣeé, kódà àwọn ibi tó ti jẹ́ ohun àìtọ́.
Zulu: Baphinde bathola ukuthi baningi abantu abasawenza ngisho nasezindaweni lapho ungekho semthethweni khona.
Hausa: Haka nan sun kuma gano cewa har yanzu mutane da dama na yin ta, ko da a wuraren da aka haramta.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba utolla gape gore bathpo ba bantši ba sa e dira, le ka mafelong ao go bego go se molaong go e dira.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ ብዙ ሰዎች ህገወጥ በሆኑባቸው ቦታዎች ሁሉ አሁንም እንደሚተገብሩት አግኝተዋል።

English: For example, in Indonesia, traditional birth attendants used a knife or needle to cut part of the clitoris (the organ mostly responsible for sexual pleasure in women) when a baby girl was 40 days old.
Luganda: Okugeza, mu ggwanga lya Indonesia, bamulerwa ab’ennono baakozesanga akambe oba empiso okubaako ekitundu ky’embugo z’obukyala (ekitundu ekireeta obwagazi mu bakyala) kye basala omwana bwe yawezanga ennaku 40 egy’obukulu.
Yoruba: Fún apẹẹrẹ, ní Indonesia, àwọn agbẹ̀bí ìbílẹ̀ má ń lo ọ̀bẹ tàbí abẹ́rẹ́ láti gé lára idọ (ọ̀kan nínú ẹ̀yà ara tí ó má ń fẹ́ jẹ́ kí obìnrin ní ìbálòpò) nígbà tí ọmọ ìkókó lóbìnrin náà bá ṣì wà ní ọmọ ogójì ọjọ́.
Zulu: Isibonelo, e-Indonesia, ababelethisi bendabuko babesebenzisa ummese noma inaliti ukusika ingxenye yobhontshisi (isitho esikhulukazi esibangela injabulo yocansi kwabesifazane) lapho ingane yentombazane inezinsuku ezingu-40 ubudala.
Hausa: Alal misali, a ƙasar Indonesiya, ma’aikatan haihuwa na gargajiya suna amfani da wuƙa ko allura don yanke wani ɓangare na ɗan-tsaka (kafar da ke da alhakin jin dadin jima’i ga mata) lokacin da yarinya ta cika kwanaki 40 da haihuwa.
Northern Sotho: Go fa mohlala, ka Indonesia, babelegiši ba setšo ba be ba šomiša thipa goba tšhwana go ripa karolo ya lelengwana la setho sa bosadi (setho seo gantši se rwelego maikarabelo a bopishino bja tša thobalano go basadi) ge ngwana wa mosetsana a fihla go mengwaga ye 40.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ፣ በኢንዶኔዥያ ባህላዊ አወላለዳን የሚተገብሩ ሰዎች አንዲት ህጻን 40 ቀናት ሲሞላት የቂንጥሩን (በሴቶች ወሲባዊ እርካታን ለማምጣት የሚጠቅም የሰውነት አካል) የተወሰነ ክፍል ለመቁረጥ መርፌ ወይም ቢላ ተጠቅመዋል ።

English: People believed this helped to ‘remove impurities’ and that it was important for religious reasons.
Luganda: Abantu baakitwala nti kino kyayambanga ‘okuggyamu obucaafu’ ate era nga kyali kya mugaso olw’ensonga z’eddiini.
Yoruba: Àwọn èèyàn gbàgbọ́ pé ó ń ṣe ìrànwọ́ láti àwọn ìdọ̀tí àti ó ṣe pàtàkì fún ẹ̀sìn ẹni.
Zulu: Abantu babekholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuyasiza ‘ekususeni ukungcola’ nokuthi kwakubalulekile ngenxa yezizathu ezingokwenkolo.
Hausa: Mutane sun gaskata cewa wannan ya taimaka wajen 'cire ƙazanta' kuma yana da mahimmanci don dalilai na addini.
Northern Sotho: Batho ba be ba dumela gore se se thuša go ‘tloša go se hlweke’ le gore go be go le bohlokwa ka mabaka a sedumedi.
Amharic: ሰዎች ይህ ‘ርክስናን ለማስወገድ’ እንዲሁም ለሃይማኖታዊ ምክንያቶች አስፈላጊ ነው ብለው ያምናሉ።

English: In Ethiopia, FGM happened even earlier, sometimes when babies were only 7 days old.
Luganda: Mu ggwanga lya Ethiopia, FGM yakolebwanga na mangu, oluusi ng’abaana baakaweza ennaku 7 zokka ez’obukulu.
Yoruba: Ní Ethiopia, FGM má ń wáyé níbẹ̀rẹ̀pẹ̀pẹ̀, nígbà mìíràn tí ọmọ ìkókó bá ṣẹ̀ pé ọjọ́ 7 tí wọ́n bi.
Zulu: E-Ethiopia, i-FGM yenzeke ngisho nangaphambi kwalokho, ngezinye izikhathi lapho izingane zinezinsuku ezingu-7 kuphela ubudala.
Hausa: A ƙasar Habasha, FGM yana faruwa da wuri, wani lokacin a lokacin da jarirai suke da kwanaki 7 kawai.
Northern Sotho: Ka Ethiopia, FGM e diregile le peleng, ka dinako tše dingwe ge masea a be a na le mengwaga ye 7.
Amharic: በኢትዮጵያ FGM ቀደም ብሎ ሁሉ ይደረግ ነበር፣ አንዳንድ ጊዜ ህጻናት 7 ቀን ሲሞላቸው ይፈጸማል።

English: The researchers found out that people there believed this would ensure the girl would be a ‘good wife’ one day, and that she would be obedient, and not aggressive to her husband.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baazuula ng’abantu mu kitundu ekyo baalina endowooza nti kino kiba kijja kukakasa nti olunaku lumu omuwala ajja kuba ‘mukyala mulungi’ ate era nti ajja kuba muwulize, sso si mubaaluufu eri bba.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ri pé àwọn èèyàn gbàgbọ́ pé èyí yóò jẹ́ kí ọmọ obìnrin náà jẹ́ ‘ìyáwó gidi’ lọ́jọ́ kan, tí ó sì ma jẹ́ ẹni tí ó ma gbọ́ràn, àti ẹni tí ò ní jẹ́ oníkanra sí ọkọ rẹ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi abantu bakhona babekholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi intombazane izoba ‘inkosikazi enhle’ ngelinye ilanga, nokuthi izolalela, futhi ingabi nobudlova kumyeni wayo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa mutanen da ksue wurin sun yi imanin cewa hakan zai tabbatar da cewa wata rana yarinyar za ta zama ‘mace ta gari’, kuma za ta kasance mai biyayya, kuma ba za ta yi tsaurin kai ga mijinta ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba utollotše gore batho ba fao ba be ba dumela gore se se tla netefatša gore mosetsana o tla ba ‘mosadi yo mokaone’ ka letšatši le lengwe, le gore o tla ba le tlhompho, le gore a se befelele monna wa gagwe.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንዳገኙት እዛ ያሉት ሰዎች ይህ አንድ ቀን ልጅቷ ‘ጥሩ ሚስት’ እንደሚወጣት እና ለባሏ ታዛዥ እንደምትሆን እና ጠበኛ እንደማትሆን ያረጋግጣል ብለው ያምናሉ።

English: Many people also believed FGM made childbirth easier but it can actually make it more difficult to give birth instead.
Luganda: Abantu bangi era baalowooza nti FGM yayanguyizanga omukyala ng’atuuse okuzaala naye ng’ekituufu kiri nti esobola okuzibuwaza ensonga y’okuzaala.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn èyàn gbàgbọ́ pé FGM má ń jẹ́ kí ọmọ bíbí rọrùn àmọ́ ó lè jẹ́ kí ọmọ bíbí nira.
Zulu: Abantu abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi i-FGM yenza ukubeletha kube lula kodwa empeleni kungakwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukuzala.
Hausa: Mutane da yawa kuma sun yi imanin cewa FGM ya sauƙaƙa haihuwa amma yana iya ƙara wahalar haihuwa maimakon haka.
Northern Sotho: Batho ba bantši gape ba be ba dumela gore FGM e dira gore pelego ya lesea e be bonolo eupša gabotse e ka dira gore go be boima kudu go belega lesea.
Amharic: እንዲሁም ብዙ ሰዎች FGM ልጅ መውለድን ያቀላል ብለው ያምኑ ነበር በአንጻሩ ግን ልጅ መውለድን የበለጠ ያከብደዋል።

English: Meanwhile in Kenya, FGM signalled that a girl had reached womanhood, and it usually happened later in life, when she was a teenager.
Luganda: Bwe kituuka mu ggwanga lya Kenya, FGM yali eraga nti omuwala afuuse mukyala, era nga yateranga kukolebwa mu biseera eby’omu maaso, nga mutiini.
Yoruba: Ní báyìí ní Kenya, FGM má ń ṣàfihàn pé ọmọdébìnrin ti di àgbàlagbà, èyí sì má ń wáyé nígbà tí wọ́n bá wà ní màjèṣín.
Zulu: Phakathi naleso sikhathi eKenya, i-FGM yayibonisa ukuthi intombazane isifinyelele ebufazini, futhi kwakuvame ukwenzeka kade ekuphileni, lapho iseyintsha.
Hausa: A halin da ake ciki a ƙasar Kenya, FGM ya nuna cewa yarinya ta kai mace, kuma yakan faru daga baya a rayuwa, lokacin da take matashiya.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale ka Kenya, FGM e be e laetša gore mosetsana o fihlile bosading, le gore ka tlwaelo se se direga ka moragonyuanba bophelong bja gagwe, ge a be a le wa mengwaga ya mahlalagading.
Amharic: ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ FGM የሚጠቁመው አንዲት ሴት ልጅ ለሴትነት እንደደረሰች ነው እና አብዛኛውን ጊዜ የሚደረገው በኋላ የጉርምስና እድሜ ላይ ስትደርስ ነው።

English: In some cases, however, they found that girls could undergo FGM as young as 8 years old, and that many girls ended up pregnant as teenagers, because they were considered old enough for sex after FGM.
Luganda: Wabula, mu mbeera ezimu baakizuula ng’abawala basobola okukolebwako FGM nga balina emyaka 8 egy’obukulu, era ng’abawala bangi baakomekkereza nga bafunye embuto nga bakyali batiini, kubanga baatwalibwa okuba abakulu ekimala era nti nga basobola okwegatta oluvannyuma lwa FGM.
Yoruba: Nígbà mìíràn ẹ̀wẹ̀, wọ́n ri pé àwọn ọmọdébìnrin tí wọ́n ò ju ọmọ ọdún mẹ́jọ lọ lèé ṣe FGM, tí ó sì jẹ́ wí pé púpọ̀ nínú àwọn ọmọdébìnrin náà ń padà lóyún ní màjèṣín nítorí wọ́n rí wọn gẹ́gẹ́ bí ẹni tó ti tó láti ní ìbálòpò lẹ́yìn FGM.
Zulu: Kwezinye izimo, nokho, bathola ukuthi amantombazane angakwazi ukwenza i-FGM esemancane kusukela eminyakeni engu-8 ubudala, nokuthi amantombazane amaningi agcina ekhulelwe esemasha, ngoba ayebhekwa njengabantu abadala ngokwanele ocansini ngemuva kwe-FGM.
Hausa: A wasu lokuta, duk da haka, sun gano cewa ‘yan mata za su iya yin FGM tun suna da shekaru 8, kuma yawancin ‘yan mata suna yin ciki tun suna matasa, saboda ana ganin sun isa yin jima'i bayan FGM.
Northern Sotho: Mabakeng a mangwe, le ge go le bjale, ba hweditše gore basetsana ba dirwa FGM ba sa le ba bannyane ka mengwaga ye 8, le gore basetsana ba bantši ba feletša ba imile ba sa le ba mengwaga ya mahlalagading, ka lebaka la gore ba be ba bonwa ba gotše ka fao go lekanego go tsenela thobalano ka morago ga go dirwa FGM.
Amharic: ነገር ግን በአንዳንድ ሁኔታዎች ሴቶች FGM የ8 አመት ልጅ እንኳ እያሉ ያደርጋሉ እና ብዙ ሴቶች ከFGM በኋላ ለግብረስጋ ግንኙነት ዝግጁ ናቸው ተብሎ ስለሚታሰብ ገና በጉርምስና እድሜያቸው ለእርግዝና ይዳረጋሉ።

English: The researchers say that their findings show there are many different reasons that FGM still happens.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti bye baazuula biraga nti waliwo ensonga nnyingi ez’enjawulo lwaki FGM ekyakolebwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé àwọn ìwádìí wọn fi han pé oríṣiríṣi ìdí ló fàá tí FGM sì ṣi ṣe ń ṣẹlẹ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi abakutholile kukhombisa ukuthi ziningi izizathu ezenza ukuthi isenzeka.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce bincikensu ya nuna akwai dalilai daban-daban da har yanzu FGM yake faruwa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bolela gore dikutollo tša bona di laetša gore go na le mabaka a mantši ao a fapafapanego a gore ke ka lebaka la eng FGM e sa direga.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደሚሉት ውጤቶቻቸው FGM አሁንም የሚከሰትበት የተለያዩ ምክንያቶች እንዳሉ ያሳያሉ።

English: As laws and social ideas change, how and where it gets done also changes.
Luganda: Amateeka n’endowooza z’abantu bwe bikyuka, engeri gye kikolebwamu ssaako ekifo we kikolebwa nabyo bikyuka.
Yoruba: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn òfin àti àwọn òye àwùjọ yípadà, bí ó ṣe di ṣíṣe àti ibi tí ó di ṣíṣe náà yípadà.
Zulu: Njengoba imithetho nemibono yezenhlalo ishintsha, ukuthi kwenziwa kanjani futhi kuphi nakho kuyashintsha.
Hausa: Yayin da dokoki da ra’ayoyin zamantakewa suka sauya, yadda da kuma inda ake yin su ma suna sauyawa.
Northern Sotho: Ka ge melao le dikgopolo tša setšhaba di fetoga, ka fao e dirwago ka gona le gore e dirwa kae le gona go a fetoga.
Amharic: ህግ እና ማህበራዊ ሃሳቦች ሲቀየሩ፣ እንዴት እና የት መደረጉም ይቀየራል።

English: For example, parents may try and get it done secretly even though it’s illegal, because they think it’s necessary for their daughter to be healthy or find a good husband.
Luganda: Okugeza, abazadde basobola okugezaako ne kikolebwa mu nkukutu newankubadde nga kimenya mateeka, kubanga balowooza nti kyetaagisa ku lwa muwala waabwe okubeera omulamu obulungi oba okufuna omusajja omulungi.
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, àwọn òbí lè gbìyànjú láti ṣé ní ìkọ̀kọ̀ bí ó ti lẹ̀ jẹ́ wí pé ó jẹ́ ohun àìtọ́,nítorí wọ́n lérò pé ó ṣe pàtàkì fún ọmọ wọn obìnrin láti ní ìléra tó péye tàbí láti rí ọkọ tó dára.
Zulu: Ngokwesibonelo, abazali bangase bazame ukukwenza ngasese nakuba kungekho emthethweni, ngoba bacabanga ukuthi kudingekile ukuba indodakazi yabo ibe nempilo enhle noma ithole umyeni omuhle.
Hausa: Misali, iyaye suna iya ƙoƙarin yin hakan a asirce ko da yake haramun ne, domin suna ganin ya dace ’yarsu ta kasance cikin ƙoshin lafiya ko kuma ta sami miji nagari.
Northern Sotho: Go fa mohlala, batswadi ba ka leka gore e dirwe ka sephiring le ge e le gore ga e molaong, ka lebaka la gore ba nagana gore go a hlokega gore barwedi ba bona go phela gabotse mebeleng goba gore ba hwetše monna yo mokaone.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ ወላጆች ህገወጥ ቢሆንም እንኳ በድብቅ ለማስደረግ ሊሞክሩ ይችላሉ ምክንያቱም ሴት ልጃቸው ጤነኛ እንድትሆን እና ጥሩ ባል እንድታገኝ አስፈላጊ ነው ብለው ሊያስቡ ይችላሉ።

English: It’s important to realise that because FGM is illegal in some places, researching the topic can be difficult, and people might not always give truthful answers about the subject.
Luganda: Kisaanye kirengeerwe nti olw’okuba FGM emenya mateeka mu bitundu ebimu, okuginoonyerezaako kusobola okubeera okuzibu, era abantu bayinza obutawa byanukulo bituufu ku nsonga eyo.
Yoruba: Ó ṣe pàtàkì láti mọ̀ pé nítorí FGM jẹ́ ohun àìtọ́ ní àwọn ibìkan, ṣíṣèwádìí kókó ọ̀rọ̀ náà léè jẹ́ ohun tó nira, àti wí pé àwọn ènìyàn lè má fún wa ní ìdáhùn òtítọ́ nípa ohun tí à ń sọ̀rọ̀ nípa rẹ̀.
Zulu: Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ngenxa yokuthi i-FGM ayikho emthethweni kwezinye izindawo, ukucwaninga ngesihloko kungase kube nzima, futhi abantu bangase banganikezi njalo izimpendulo eziyiqiniso mayelana nesihloko.
Hausa: Yana da mahimmanci a gane cewa saboda FGM ba bisa ƙa’ida ba ne a wasu wurare, bincika batun zai iya zama da wahala, kuma mutane ba koyaushe suke bayar da amsoshi na gaskiya game da batun ba.
Northern Sotho: Go bohlokwa go lemoga gore ka gobane FGM ga e molaong mafelong a mangwe, go nyakišiša ka ga hlogotaba ye go ka ba boima, gomme batho ga se ka mehla ba ka fana ka dikarabo tša nnete ka ga hlogotaba ye.
Amharic: ይህንን መገንዘብ አስፈላጊ ነው ምክንያቱም በአንዳንድ ቦታዎች FGM ህገወጥ ነው፣ ስለጉዳዩ ምርምር ማድረግ ከባድ ሊሆን ይችላል እና ሰዎች ስለ ጉዳዩ ሁልጊዜ እውነተኛ መልስ ላይሰጡ ይችላሉ።

English: In the future, in addition to making it illegal, the researchers say governments and health authorities should aim to stop FGM by addressing the false beliefs people have about the practice and educating them on the dangers.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bagamba nti mu biseera eby’omu maaso, ng’ogasseeko okugiwera, gavumenti n’ebitongole by’ebyobulamu bisaanye biruubirire okukomya FGM nga biyita mu kukola ku nzikiriza enkyamu abantu ze balina ku nkola eno awamu n’okubasomesa ku kabi akagirimu.
Yoruba: Ní ọjọ́ iwájú, láfikún láti sọọ́ di ohun àìtọ́, àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé àwọn ìjọba àti àwọn aláṣe elétò ìlera gbọdọ̀ ní èròńgbà láti dẹ́kun FGM nípa ṣíṣálàyé ìgbàgbọ́ èké tí àwọn èèyàn ní nípa ìṣesí yìí kí wọ́n si sọ àwọn ìjàm̀bá tó rọ̀mọ fún wọn.
Zulu: Esikhathini esizayo, ngaphezu kokwenza kube semthethweni, abacwaningi bathi ohulumeni neziphathimandla zezempilo kufanele bahlose ukumisa i-FGM ngokubhekana nezinkolelo ezingamanga abantu abanazo ngalo mkhuba futhi babafundise ngezingozi.
Hausa: A nan gaba, baya ga haramta shi, masu binciken sun ce ya kamata gwamnatoci da hukumomin kiwon lafiya su yi niyyar dakatar da FGM ta hanyar magance imanin ƙaryar da mutane suke da shi game da wannan al’ada tare da ilmantar da su game da haɗarorin.
Northern Sotho: Ka moso, godimo ga go dira gore e se be molaong, banyakišiši ba bolela gore mebušo le ba taolo ya tša maphelo ba swanetše go ikemišetša go thiba FGM ka go rarolla ditumelo tše di fošagetšego tše batho ba nago le tšona ka ga tiro ye le go ba ruta ka ga dikotsi tša yona.
Amharic: ወደፊት ህገወጥ ከማድረግ በተጨማሪ ተመራማሪዎቹ መንግስታት እና የጤና ባለስልጣናት ሰዎች ስለጉዳዩ ያለቸውን የተሳሳተ አስተሳሰብ በማስተካከል እና ስለሚያደርሳቸው አደጋዎች በማስተማር FGMን ለማቆም ማለም አለባቸው።

English: This study was a collaboration between scientists from Ethiopia, Indonesia and the Netherlands, and forms part of a bigger project, called the ‘Yes I Do programme’, whicht aims to reduce teen pregnancies, child marriage and FGM.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwakolebwa omukago gwa bannassaayansi okuva mu ggwanga lya Ethiopia, Indonesia ne Budaaki, era nga kuli kitundu ku pulojekiti engazi, eyitibwa ‘Yes I Do programme’, eruubirira okukendeeza ku muwendo gw’abatiini abafuna embuto, abaana abato okugenda mu bufumbo awamu ne FGM.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí jẹ́ ìfọwọ́sowópọ̀ àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́nsì láti Ethiopia, Indonesia àti ní Netherland láti ṣẹ̀dá iṣẹ́ àkànṣe tó tóbi ju lọ tí wọ́n pè ní ‘Ètò bẹ́ẹ̀ni mo ṣe’, tí ó sì ní èròńgbà láti ṣe ìdínkù sí oyún níní màjèṣín, ìgbéyàwó ọmọdé àti FGM.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo bekuwukubambisana phakathi kososayensi base-Ethiopia, Indonesia kanye ne-Netherlands, futhi luyingxenye yohlelo olukhulu, olubizwa nge-‘Yebo ngiyavuma”, okuhloswe ngalo ukunciphisa ukukhulelwa kwentsha, umshado wezingane kanye ne-FGM.
Hausa: Wannan binciken haɗin gwiwa ne a tsakanin masana kimiyya daga ƙasashen Habasha da Indonesia da kuma Netherlands, kuma ya kasance wani ɓangare na babban aiki, mai suna Yes I Do programme’', wanda yake nufin rage ɗaukar ciki na matasa da auren yara da kuma FGM.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše e bile tirišano magareng ga bašomi ba tša mahlale go tšwa ka Ethiopia, Indonesia le ka Netherlands, gomme di bopa karolo ya protšeke ye kgolo, ye e bitšwago ‘lenaneo la Yes I Do’, leo le ikemišeditšego go fokotša boimana bja basetsana ba mahlalagading, go nyala bana le FGM.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት በኢትዮጵያ፣ በኢንዶኔዥያ እና በኔዘርላንደስ ሳይንቲስቶች ትብብር የተሰራ ሲሆን ‘የስ አይ ዱ ፕሮግራም’ የሚባል በጉርምስና ጊዜ የሚከሰቱ እርግዝናዎችን፣ የልጅነት ጋብቻን እና FGMን ለመቀነስ ያለመ ትልቅ ፕሮጀክት አካል ነው።
